intro: The app captures on this website and in Vivid's App Store listing show Vivid running on a demo library of the films and series below. Their posters, backdrops, title logos and episode stills belong to their studios and other rights holders, and are shown only to illustrate how Vivid presents a library. The artwork and metadata come from TMDB. This product uses the TMDB API but is not endorsed or certified by TMDB. Vivid isn't affiliated with or endorsed by any of these titles' owners, and it doesn't provide, sell or stream any of them: it plays media from your own Silo, Emby or Jellyfin server.
